## WF-06 - Intelligent Routing & Decision Engine

Standalone, reusable sub-workflow. Called by WF-05 (Alarm Correlation & Deduplication) via an Execute Workflow node. Takes one correlated incident and decides WHO handles it, HOW urgently, and BY WHEN - producing the assignedTeam, priority, notificationPolicy, escalationLevel, slaDeadline and businessImpact fields that WF-07 (Notification Dispatcher) requires. Closes the WF-05 -> WF-07 schema gap identified in production validation.

## Team Assignment Matrix

Maps each normalized alarmType (from WF-02) to a team, using the exact team names WF-07 TEAM_CHAT_MAP expects so every alarm resolves to a real Telegram destination. Unmapped alarm types fall back to NOC.

## Priority & Notification Policy

Priority comes from the root alarm own priority (WF-03 AI + business rules) - the most alarm-specific signal available. notificationPolicy maps priority to delivery urgency: Critical -> immediate, Major -> urgent, Minor -> standard, Warning -> digest.

## Escalation & SLA

escalationLevel L1 (highest) for Critical priority or alarm storms (>3 correlated child alarms), L2 for Major, L3 for Minor/Warning. immediateEscalation drives WF-07 urgency marker. slaDeadline is now + a response window sized to priority (Critical 30m, Major 2h, Minor 8h, Warning 24h).

## Error Handling

Missing incidentId / siteId / vendor / region / rootAlarm.alarmType -> Error Output - Invalid Input, listing exactly what is missing. Unmapped alarm type -> not an error, falls back to NOC. Missing rootAlarm.priority -> derived from businessPriority instead of blocking.
